mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, message, link_url, target_type, target_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{linkUrl}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, type, title, message, link_url AS linkUrl, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'normal' AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND state = 'normal'
UPDATE notifications SET state = 'deleted' WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'normal'
